title: Forms of energy
subject: science
strengths: Most of the class can name the five forms of energy.
The class can describe how electrical energy changes into light and heat at a bulb.

modelAnswers.question: Name the five forms of energy shown at the start of the animation.
modelAnswers.answer: Light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy.

modelAnswers.question: A car is moving along the road. What energy change is happening inside the car?
modelAnswers.answer: It changes stored energy in its fuel into movement energy (and some heat).

commonErrors.misconception: Energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank.
commonErrors.example: A learner writes on the worksheet that the lamp energy was used up when it stopped shining.

fixIt.prompt: Fix it: say what really happens to the energy when a lamp stops shining.
fixIt.corrected: Corrected working: the energy is never used up - it changed into light and heat and moved into the room.

commonErrors.misconception: Energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank.
commonErrors.example: On the exit ticket, a learner says the energy disappeared when a toy car slowed down and stopped.

fixIt.prompt: Fix it: rewrite the sentence so the energy changes form and moves somewhere else instead of disappearing.
fixIt.corrected: Corrected check: energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else.

nextSteps: Reteach the trap, landing that energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else.
Practise the energy-change check from the worked example - name where the energy waits, follow it as it travels, then name the forms it becomes.
